summary: postinstall fetches and executes a binary from a hardcoded bare-IP host with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall hook downloads a platform tarball from a hardcoded bare IPv4 endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz) with certificate validation explicitly disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false), extracts it via `tar -xzf`, marks the extracted binary executable (chmod 0o755), and hardlinks it into the launcher's bin directory. No hash or signature verification is performed and the source is not a publisher-owned domain or a package registry. This fires automatically on `npm install`. Whoever controls that IP address — or any on-path attacker, given TLS validation is off — can deliver arbitrary executable code to every installer at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
